environment.description: Flask application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer with an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL. The WebACL includes a custom request inspection rule (Priority 1) that validates POST requests to /api/v1/announcements against a JSON body schema using a regex pattern set. The rule uses a RegexPatternSet named 'announcement-body-allowlist' with pattern '^[\w\s.,!?@#$%&*()\-+=:;\/\[\]{}"'\n\r]{1,5000}$' applied via JsonBody match on fields 'title', 'body', and 'author' with OversizeHandling set to BLOCK. Requests where any field fails the pattern match receive a BLOCK action with custom response code 403. Note: the regex deliberately excludes angle brackets (<>), backticks, and several other characters commonly used in XSS vectors. The WAFv2 rule also has a secondary TextTransformation of URL_DECODE applied before matching, preventing encoded bypass attempts.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with WAFv2 WebACL association
config.network: private subnet, ALB in public subnet
config.runtime: Python 3.11, Flask 3.0, gunicorn on ECS Fargate
